title: Axolotl Fine-Tuning
description: Serverless fine-tuning of open-source LLMs with Axolotl. Supports LoRA, QLoRA, DPO, and more using Hugging Face models and datasets.

input.name: Hugging Face Token
input.description: Token for gated models/datasets and for pushing results to the Hub. May also be supplied per job via input.credentials.hf_token.

input.name: Weights & Biases API Key
input.description: API key for logging training runs to Weights & Biases. May also be supplied per job via input.credentials.wandb_api_key.

input.name: Base Volume
input.description: Directory that fine-tuning outputs and the Hugging Face caches are written to.
